note: Round 13 (Larus GL-2). Not gate files. Every number was measured by the scripts named (scratchpad r13/ is the physics agent's scratch directory; candidates and evidence copied under out/sweep/round13/). Verdict: no candidate passes M1-M8; v21 stays in data/designs and out/verification.

rows.tag: 1 wing loading (aspect ratio at the 2.0 m span cap)
rows.method: src/design/round13.mjs candidates over v21 (ROUND12.set): AR 5.5 / 5 / 4.75 / 4.5 with the spar moved forward in the chord (sparFrac) so the battery stays in v21's pod; built --no-suction (eta_s 0.6) with the trim-refine retry; M1 = scratchpad r13/m1probe.mjs (27 cases, the design's own launch law, 1/3840 s); M4 = r13/m4probe.mjs seeds 1-30 at nominal. Not gate files.

M1.source: round 12 at eta_s 0.6 (scratchpad r12/v21-m1.log, v21-m1-launch.log v0)

rows.reading: M1 closes at WL <= 20.4 N/m2 (AR <= 4.75 at 2.0 m): every case loses under 1.5 m and climbs over 2-3 s. AR 5 (WL 21.3) loses at most 1.28 m but one case (aero 0.9 / mass 1.05 / CG -5 mm, 10 deg) sinks 0.04 m/s over 2-3 s. The same area costs M4 and M7: nominal M4 falls from 30/30 (v21) to 29, 27, 26, 22 of 30 (all on altitude, the downdraft climb), and the M4 crank peak rises with area from 14.83 to 16.65, 17.50, 18.61, 19.32 N m against the 16.24 N m train (the M7 gear limit). No point of the sweep passes both.

rows.tag: 1b best candidate c475 (AR 4.75), eta_s table and its own V5 calibration
rows.design: out/sweep/round13/c475.json (node src/design/round13.mjs --cand c475 --cal <V5 multipliers of its own wing>)
rows.V5: PASS on its own wing: worst held-out lift 2.1%, thrust 2.7% (out/sweep/round13/evidence/V5-c475r.json; flown in a scratch copy, not out/verification)
rows.verdict: FAIL, not a v22. M1 passes with the table (0/27, worst 0.491 m, slowest 2-3 s climb 0.05 m/s) but fails at the uniform 0.6 default (10/27, worst 1.146 m, a case sinking 0.42 m/s), so by the CFD round-3 addition its M1 verdict is not final: every strip sits below the measured band and is held at 0.732. M4 96/100 at nominal and at aero 0.9 / mass 1.05 / CG +5 (needs 98; seeds 8, 15, 27, 45, all altitude). M7: the passing nominal M4 seeds peak at 18.34 N m at the crank against the 16.24 N m train (13% over). M2 16.24 min, M3 0.74 m, M5 7.57 m/s / 0.69 m/s pass at every corner. Shortfall to v22: about 2.1 N m of crank torque (a train 13% stronger costs 179-215 g, which the sweep shows breaks M1), 2+ M4 seeds, and a lower-amplitude CFD point or M1 margin that survives eta_s 0.6.

rows.tag: 2 low-speed lift: twist, symmetric twist, lead (static level flapping trims)
rows.method: scratchpad r13/vmin.mjs: trimLevel (the build's own cycle trim, twist servo through its real speed model) walked down 0.25 m/s then bisected to 0.05; the floor is the slowest trim with stroke frequency within the envelope.
rows.reading: None moves the floor by more than 0.13 m/s. At the floor the trim jumps from 2.4 Hz with 16% of the wing stalled to above 5.7 Hz with 60% stalled: below it no stroke within any rating balances drag, so stroke speed, pack voltage (3S or 4S) and the launch frequency cannot help (round 12: launch 2.3-2.9 Hz gave 2.915-2.942 m).

rows.tag: 3 M4 and M7 levers on the large wing (c45r, AR 4.5)

stronger_train.design: c45t2: the lightest no-mixed-mesh train for 20 N m at 4 Hz (r12/trainsearch12.mjs: 652 g of gears against 437 g; 17 N m needs 616 g, 22 N m 765 g)

rows.reading: The crank peak is aerodynamic (about 1.33 x the crank torque at the peak, inertia -0.3): rough-air speed, GLA and lower clamps move it by at most 1.8 N m and each costs M4 seeds; smaller strokes cut the peak less than the speed-derated train and break M1; the 20 N m train carries the peak (19.40 of 20.12) but its 280 g puts the wing loading back to 22.5 N/m2, where M1 fails 12 of 27.

rows.finding: At v21's spar position (0.35 chord) a lower aspect ratio moves the neutral point forward relative to the hinge and enlarges the tail moment (tail area x arm goes as S x mac), so the CG target puts the battery 0.2 m further forward (0.457 m at AR 5 against 0.256 m): its gears then sit in the pod's aft taper and the body fit fails, and lengthening the pod puts the battery on a forward tray that fails its own rating (FoS 1.35-2.3 at the calm cruise). Moving the spar forward to 0.28-0.33 of the chord moves the neutral point aft with it and returns the battery to 0.24-0.32 m in v21's pod (r13/fitprobe.mjs).

The low-aspect-ratio wings fly about 30% more stroke frequency in free flight than their frozen-body trims, and on the first refine pass every row but one missed only the 2% frequency-drift tolerance (2.1-2.4%), so the old refine dropped them and left a one-row table (c45: 9.5 m/s only). src/design/trim.js keptTrimRows (opt.trimFlight { passes: 3, retry: true }, round 13 only) carries such a row into the next pass with its flight means and keeps converged rows only at the last pass. Default behaviour unchanged. For the code checks refineTrimByFlight was split into flyTrimRow / trimRowRecord / keptTrimRows and completeDesign into trimTable / finishControl (CRAP 360 and 141 before, every touched function under 30 after); v21 rebuilt by round12.mjs with the split code and the committed film checker reproduces data/designs v21 exactly (mass 1708.274 g, trim table, free-flight rows, envelope 3.3226 Hz, Vapp 9.071; scratchpad r13/headcheck).
rows.tests: test/design/round13.test.js (8: hand sums for the row verdict and tolerances, the window counts and bounds on the v20 fixture, the pass hand-on, cruise selection, candidate sets)

rows.finding: To pass M1 at v21's area the sweep needs WL <= 20.4 N/m2, i.e. at most 1387 g against 1708 g (-321 g, -19%); 437 g of it is the gear train that sets the M7 limit and 164 g the battery. No saving of that size is allowed by the rules; it was not pursued part by part.
